name: Hiyoru
summary: Hiyoru is a free-to-play dark fantasy digital card game inspired by Japanese folklore. In a world where the Sun no longer sets and the Night has been forgotten, players summon creatures from 14 dynasties, cast Techniques and Rituals and battle with 30-card decks. The game features a story campaign with 75 battles and two endings, matches against the computer at four difficulty levels, online duels, Draft, weekly tournaments, a ranked mode and puzzles. It can be played in the browser or through a launcher for Windows.
